title: Building Patterns
summary: Combine loops with variables to draw patterns, shapes, and repeating designs.

content.title: Loops Make Art
content.summary: Run the same print statement many times and you get a repeating pattern.
content.body:
Loops are great for patterns. Run the same print statement many times and you get a design:

for i in range(5):
    print("* * *")

Output:
* * *
* * *
* * *
* * *
* * *

Five identical rows — written with only two lines of code.

content.title: Growing Patterns with i
content.summary: Multiply a string by i to make each row longer as the loop counts up.
content.body:
When you use i inside print(), each row can be different:

for i in range(1, 6):
    print("#" * i)

Output:
#
##
###
####
#####

"#" * i repeats the # character i times. As i grows, the row gets longer.

content.title: Mixing Text and i
content.summary: Combine a label with a growing pattern to create level-up style displays.
content.body:
You can mix fixed text with the counter to label each row:

for i in range(1, 4):
    print("Level", i, ":", "*" * i)

Output:
Level 1 : *
Level 2 : **
Level 3 : ***

Each line has the level number and a growing row of stars.

content.title: Your Turn to Design
content.summary: There is no single right answer — experiment with different characters and ranges.
content.body:
Pattern ideas to try:

• A staircase of dashes: "-" * i
• A triangle of dots: "." * i
• A shrinking bar: "#" * (10 - i)
• A score board with rows labeled Round 1, Round 2...

There is no single right answer — experiment and see what appears!

editorPrompt: Draw a triangle of stars that grows from 1 star on row 1 to 5 stars on row 5.
starterCode:
# Draw a growing triangle of stars
# Row 1: *
# Row 2: **
# Row 3: ***
# Row 4: ****
# Row 5: *****
progressiveHints: Use range(1, 6) so i goes from 1 to 5.
Inside the loop, print "*" * i — that repeats * exactly i times.
Challenge: can you make it shrink back down again using a second loop?
challenge: After the growing triangle, add a second loop that makes the triangle shrink from 5 stars back to 1. Together they form a diamond shape!
